## Intent
Hypothesis: compiler auto-vectorization over per-particle components can approach the streaming ceiling on low-churn workloads.

## Cache saturation
At all death rates, N=4000 sits past the L1d spill (N≈910) but within L2, showing elevated ns/p (11.241 at q=0.01) from overhead amortization. Cost falls and flattens by N=16000 (7.979) and stays flat through N=262000 (7.823) — across the L2→DRAM spill at N≈58254 with no knee. At q=0.01 the curve dips slightly from N=16000 to N=262000, then rises to 8.116 at N=4M. Death rate raises the floor (q=0.25: 10–12 ns/p) but preserves the same shape: overhead at small N, flat at large N, no spill knee.

## Bandwidth
Peak achieved is 9.2 GB/s at N=262000, q=0.01 — 36.5% of the 25.22 GB/s ceiling. Overhead-bound at small N (6.4 GB/s at N=4000), compute/overhead-bound at large N, never bandwidth-bound: the absence of an L2→DRAM knee confirms DRAM is not the limiter. At q=0.25, bandwidth falls to 5.85–7.14 GB/s as respawn-merge cost rises with churn. The cell never approaches bandwidth-bound behavior at any N or death rate.

## Assembly
The compiler vectorized across components of one particle, not across particles. The update loop loads 4 floats via `ldr q16, [x13]` and 2 via `ldr d17, [x13, #0x10]`, rearranges with `ext.16b v18, v16, v17, #0xc`, inserts a lane via `mov.s v18[3], v7[0]`, then computes `fmul.4s v7, v18, v3` and `fadd.4s v7, v16, v7` before `str q7` and `str d7`. An indexed gather appears as `ld1.s {v17}[1], [x14]`. The scatter phase is scalar byte ops — `ldrb`/`strb` with `csel` clamping — which cannot stream, capping bandwidth at 36.5% of ceiling.

## Verdict
Refuted — the cell peaks at 9.2 GB/s = 36.5% of the 25.22 GB/s ceiling (N=262000, q=0.01) with no L2→DRAM spill knee (flat 7.8 ns/p from N=16000 through N=262000), confirming compute/overhead-bound behavior. Component-wise auto-vectorization (`fmul.4s`, `fadd.4s`) covers the update, but byte-granular scatter (`strb`/`ldrb`) prevents streaming, and death rate raises the floor from 7.8 to 12.2 ns/p at q=0.25 without changing the N-shape.
